desc:
🌈 Welcome to Infinite Hug Tower! 🌈

🤗 Hug players to throw them!
🪙 Get +1 coin for every step!
😈 Use coins to buy cool items, move faster, have fun, or troll other players!
👑 Finish the tower 10 times to unlock free permanent Admin!

🎉 Finish the tower for a special surprise! 
👍 Thumbs up if you enjoyed the game!
⭐ Favorite if you really enjoyed the game!
